note: Rust hot-path performance and fixes: vespera_dispatch_async no longer builds (and, with tracing, logs) a 503 wire after every successful callback; DIRECT resumable dispatch zeroes the stash handle area on non-stash overflows, asks for the 1 KiB minimum like dispatchDirect0, and stashes / re-stashes under the runtime lease with a shutdown re-check; set_default_multipart_limits replaces both limits atomically; cancel wakes outside the shard lock with cache-line padded shards; common non-standard request header names are interned; the streaming paths share the URI with the header bytes; InputStream.close uses the cached method id; the header callback drops a redundant local frame; the chunk-buffer graveyard is checked with an atomic flag; serve sets TCP_NODELAY
